text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
With this, Chiyo-chan has climbed yet 
another step up the staircase to 
adulthood♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm a year older... though I'm 
nowhere near it yet, I hope I can get 
closer to Maruzen-san, both in maturity 
and skill.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Look at you, Chiyo-chan, talking big 
now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry...! Was I being too cheeky?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on, I say! Though I'm not about 
to lose just yet, either♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I always want to be a cool and awesome 
senior to you, Chiyo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
M-Maruzen-san...! You're so dazzling... so 
totally radical...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, someday I wanna be, um... well... A 
totally rad, feverish, super-duper 
chobeliba kind of Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Totally rad, babe♪ Though maybe you still 
need a little more training to become a 
truly wicked young gal?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~ Diligence... Wait, no, I'll do my 
mangos-best...!
